method: Independent validation re-grade of all six saved complete answers against the pre-registered semantic rule; not blind, no new model runs. Read grader before answers. Current-3 counted as pass; conservative toward the claimed benefit.

rows.name: current-1
rows.basis: Defines one booking-attempt identity checked after every await, links it to F5 and F6 and other continuation sites.

rows.name: current-2
rows.basis: Recognizes the broader late-response class but prescribes screen/detour currency separately from the slot-bound key; no one attempt identity shared across the findings.

rows.name: current-3
rows.basis: Names one class: an await continuation acts without checking it is still the same booking attempt, then binds every listed site and the summary key to the current attempt. Accept as semantic identity; no literal attemptId token required by the grader.

rows.name: mechanism-1
rows.basis: Says the attempt has no identity of its own; one token record is checked by callbacks and governs context changes across multiple findings.

rows.name: mechanism-2
rows.basis: Explicit attemptId and isCurrent shared across late callbacks and the fresh F6 send; ties the common mechanism to F1/F2/F5/F6.

rows.name: mechanism-3
rows.basis: Says the booking has no identity of its own; expands root draft revision to include slot context and has every continuation and send check that record.

limits: One qnow case; three Claude runs per arm; one-run margin; no statistical/general improvement claim.
The known validation input already names actual booking attempt/slot; the leak scan does not prove absence of semantic hints.
All six answers recognize the late-response class; success measures identity framing, not repair success or code correctness.
Replay recommendations and authority claims are unvalidated advice; they do not authorize qnow changes.
